summary: Birkenstock Holding plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the date of its fiscal Q4 and full-year 2026 results (period ended September 30, 2026). Results will be released December 10, 2026 before the US market open, with a conference call and webcast at 8:00 a.m. ET that day. No transaction, securities offering, or corporate action is disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings-scheduling notice and contains no deal terms, premium, advisor, or regulatory mechanics. Watch only for the December 10 results and guidance commentary as catalysts.
